shared_requirements.requirement: Server derives actor identity; enforce resource/action permissions and database grants/policies. Ordinary command handlers must not rely on privileged RLS-bypassing credentials for authorization. Validated writes atomically update domain state, append an event and store a command receipt. Keys are scoped to actor/resource; repeated keys return the original result, changed payloads conflict, and semantic duplicates do not create duplicate effective actions.

Events include event_id, schema_version, aggregate_id/version, actor_id, source, occurred_at, recorded_at, correlation_id and idempotency_key. Protect sensitive payloads; keep audit access separate. Corrections preserve the prior action while retained.
Store instants in UTC plus the participant time zone and applicable local_date. Distinguish reported occurrence time from server acknowledgement; validate backdating and ambiguous dates.

Nancy supports user-initiated two-way voice with real microphone input and spoken responses in S01. Voice and touch invoke the same authenticated typed commands. Keep credentials/tools server-owned, sessions bounded, ambiguity explicit and saved/pending/failed responses truthful. Dictated text alone is not voice acceptance. Use GPT Sol with high reasoning behind the speech layer. Client, family/friend and administrator interactions are principally voice; every role has a complete UI path as its features ship. Subscription-backed text reasoning and an MCP tunnel do not supply speech entitlement or prove an audio conversation. Qualify the speech provider/device path independently; the chosen GPT-6 Sol high remains the reasoning backend. One tap opens a continuous voice session; explicit End closes immediately. Initial tunable defaults: 1.2 seconds of end-of-turn silence, 30 seconds idle plus a visible/audible 10-second closure grace; never count idle while Nancy is speaking or thinking. Support user interruption of speech only after device echo/false-trigger checks. Foreground Hey Nancy requires opt-in, visible listening state, bounded audio handling and a qualified actual-device path; no automatic background phone wake is implied.

Maintain simple queryable projections from transactional records/events. IDs, plan/protocol versions and consent-scoped queries support later reports without a dashboard or a separate analytics platform.

From S01 local database commits survive refresh/process restart, uncertain writes are reconciled by receipt, and disconnected actions never claim success. Verify encrypted backup export/restore before retaining meaningful data. S03 adds durable pending device commands, interruption recovery and revocation-safe cache handling.

Automated synthetic regression and live acceptance run together. Test denial and duplicate/correction cases; log sanitized evidence IDs, revision, environment, time and observer. Keep destructive tests off active care records. Live means the actual deployed local database/auth path, real configured GPT/speech services and intended device; cloud database hosting is not required and disposable PGlite tests alone are insufficient.

Draft/proposed day and meal plans are separate from accepted immutable versions from S01. Explicit acceptance binds the exact reviewed version and current observations; later edits create revisions. Actual task/meal reports introduced in S02 remain factual history when a plan changes.

External completion intent and local transition commit together. Workers lease jobs, retry within bounds, reconcile unknown outcomes and expose pending/failed state. Do not promise exactly one network request.

Keep service charges under the confirmed budget; track ChatGPT-plan allowance separately from metered GPT reasoning/speech. Qualify the existing subscription first. Quota/auth failures are visible and recoverable; no silent switch to API billing, different model, top-up or paid upgrade, and no deletion of required care history. Non-GPT speech costs stay inside the service ceiling.

Treat model output as untrusted proposed intent. Validate exact task/meal identities, allowed fields, consent and expected versions; reject unknown targets and clinical rule changes. A fluent reply or proposed completion never proves a saved plan or performed activity.

Voice intent and buttons share a typed, role-authorized destination registry. Reject unknown or unauthorized targets; clearly explain features not yet available. Navigation alone cannot mutate a plan or report activity. Preserve My Day as the client home; avoid adding setup/clinical complexity to it. Session-start priority is computed from current authorized local calendar entries, scheduled task/meal windows, actual reports and unresolved work; each suggestion cites the relevant record/time and asks before changing a schedule.

Tasks expose what, urgency (high/medium/low) and scheduled date/time. Meals are tasks with linked meal details, not a second competing task ledger. Persist stable occurrence IDs and date/time context from the accepted plan; S02 adds actual reports. Planning/acceptance does not mark an item completed or eaten. Capture proposed duration or unknown in planning and preserve it with the plan. In S02 maintain actual performed/eaten/deferred times separately, and in S04 explicitly review missed prior-day occurrences.

Check supported typed tool round trips, isolation, token renewal, revocation, timeouts and quota refusal. No shared Cerberus credentials or silent API/model fallback. If unsupported, record the exact blocker and prepare the API fallback with costs for owner decision.

Select and qualify speech independently using small live synthetic audio tests and the actual target microphone/speaker. Use one durable check-in identity per participant/local date from S01; S04 extends this record rather than creating a second session ledger. Replace participant/caregiver role assumptions with administrator/client/family_friend/clinician and scoped grants. Unify planned meals with task occurrence IDs; add urgency and scheduled date/time. Preserve IDs across migration.
Implement get_daily_brief, propose_day_plan, accept_day_plan, revise_day_plan and get_day_plan; bind exact IDs and expected versions and keep suggestions separate from acceptance.

Any Secure MCP Tunnel needs separate scoped access and deny/revocation tests and is optional. Independently qualify My Day HTTPS for the intended device; never route care data through the LifeCore store.

Bind authenticated voice tools and buttons to the same authorized navigation and exact-version care commands. Keep account/tunnel mechanics out of My Day; test cancellation, ambiguity, quota/auth refusal and truthful committed state.

acceptance_criteria.assertion: On the actual device, Nancy hears speech and replies audibly while reviewing genuine tasks and meal choices for the correct local day.
A proposed day/meal plan becomes accepted only through an explicit action bound to the reviewed version; unsupported or ambiguous changes require clarification.
Authenticated voice/touch commands save once, reject unknown targets or stale versions, enforce participant permissions and announce saved only after commit.
Accepted plans and revisions survive refresh and API restart with auditable history and exact readback; backup/restore scope is demonstrated on disposable records.
My Day exposes the same saved tasks/meals and honest failure state through voice and touch, including when speech or a remote provider is unavailable.

All four roles reach their appropriate scoped home. Client task/meal views can be opened by voice and buttons; unavailable, unknown and unauthorized destinations fail explicitly without changing care records.

Tasks show what, urgency and scheduled local date/time or an explicit unscheduled state. A planned meal has one shared task occurrence identity across task/meal views; acceptance never implies completion.

The live deployment stores durable care data locally and uses gpt-6-sol high through an explicitly selected, qualified inference/auth/billing route behind independently qualified two-way speech. Evidence identifies runtime/model/effort, account/deployment eligibility, usage limits, local data path and browser HTTPS. Quota/auth failure never silently changes billing/model; any MCP tunnel remains scoped tool transport.

A button starts a continuous natural-feeling voice session; turns wait for a configurable silence threshold, a visible delayed idle close preserves context, speaking/thinking suspends idle, End closes immediately, and interruption does not make Nancy hear her own audio as a user request.

The participant can audition free voices and select a preferred voice on the intended device. With explicit consent, foreground Hey Nancy starts the same authorized conversation, shows listening state and stops cleanly; button entry remains available if wake listening is unavailable. No background phone or on-device-only wake claim is made. A consenting tester must demonstrate the foreground wake path on a qualified intended route; if the selected phone cannot support it, the wake criterion remains open until a supported path or explicit owner scope change. Button fallback does not count as a passed wake test. Voice acceptance includes satisfactory intonation, phrasing, pauses, emphasis and warmth on varied utterances; audible playback alone cannot pass the naturalness gate.

Lets Plan the Day and Lets Plan Today open one morning planning flow. On each start Nancy uses current local appointments, tasks, meals and available actuals to explain time-aware priorities, propose realistic duration/urgency/calendar placement and ask before saving changes. Unknown preparation or travel buffers are asked about, and absent external calendar data is disclosed rather than invented.

Nancy presents multiple feasible meal choices, handles no-choice and missing-ingredient responses, discusses portions within supplied constraints and adds only a confirmed missing item to the minimal grocery list with one effective command receipt.

human_action_policy.source: Each slice's human_actions array is authoritative; docs/HUMAN_ACTIONS.md is its generated reading view.
human_action_policy.agent_responsibility: Build, configure, debug, migrate, test and prepare concrete reviewable outputs within existing authorization. Do not turn routine technical work into human chores.
human_action_policy.carry_forward: Reuse existing access, consent, decisions and valid evidence. Never request the same authorization again merely because another slice needs it.
human_action_policy.timing: Ask only when the action is needed; continue independent authorized work while waiting. A list entry is a future requirement, not an immediate request.
human_action_policy.conditional_actions: Apply a conditional item only when its condition is true. Record not_applicable with a specific reason when false; an agent may establish this from evidence without asking the user. Reassess the status when the trigger changes.
human_action_policy.completion: A slice cannot be done while an applicable slice_completion human action is unfinished. Paid-commitment, daily-reliance, clinical-use and release-gate items block only that named operation/gate, not unrelated free or supervised feature work.
human_action_policy.evidence: Done requires an actual completion reference and timestamp; record private or sanitized references, not names, credentials, clinical records or invented signoffs.
human_action_policy.roles: Human-action owner labels describe responsibilities, not application permissions. The application has exactly four roles: administrator, client, family/friend and clinician. One person may hold several responsibilities; the project owner is confirmed as both administrator and technical lead. Keep account identities private.
human_action_policy.deferred: Company Outlook/IT consent is required only for the deferred Outlook integration; it is not a prerequisite for these MVP slices.

product_contract.navigation_policy: Voice intent and buttons share a typed, role-authorized destination registry. Reject unknown or unauthorized targets; clearly explain features not yet available. Navigation alone cannot mutate a plan or report activity. Preserve My Day as the client home; avoid adding setup/clinical complexity to it.

task_model.schedule_policy: Persist the scheduled instant with participant time zone/local date; display the date/time in that zone. An unknown time is explicitly unscheduled until supplied, never invented. S02 rescheduling preserves old/new values, actor, versions and an event. Capture a proposed duration (or explicit unknown) and ask whether an appointment or task should occupy a proposed local calendar slot; only an explicitly accepted version changes the schedule. At session start rank impending appointments, meals, overdue tasks and commitments from current facts. This is assistance, not an autonomous calendar mutation.
task_model.meal_policy: A planned meal has one task occurrence identity and meal-specific details. Task list and meal view project the same record; accepting a meal plan does not mean eaten, and one meal report must not double count completion. Offer multiple household-appropriate choices and a collaborative alternative/healthier modification path; discuss portions within approved preferences and avoid unsupported clinical dietary prescriptions. Confirm missing ingredients before adding them to a minimal grocery list.
task_model.internal_metadata: Stable IDs, kind, participant, versions, source and audit fields remain internal; keep the client-facing form simple.

product_contract.family_notification_policy: Per-recipient opt-in and client-scoped sharing grants, including meal tasks. Notify only committed activity or schedule changes; recheck grants at delivery, suppress effective duplicates and honor revocation. No notification is sent merely because Nancy suggested a plan.
product_contract.clinical_dashboard_policy: S12 supplies archetype-specific configurations and authorized data exports. Prepare reviewable metric/export definitions with clinical partners before enabling them; do not infer treatment targets or diagnoses. Achievement UI design remains later in S09.

data_hosting.database_target: Local PostgreSQL; qualify deployment and compatible local authentication within S01.
data_hosting.migration_policy: Versioned schema migrations and encrypted, tested export/restore preserve IDs, grants, plans, reports, events and receipts. Durable state stays in the care service; do not couple identity/domain commands to one hosting vendor.
data_hosting.cloud_processing: GPT inference remains remote; speech processing location depends on the independently qualified local or hosted speech path. Document actual remote processing before retaining care data; local durable storage does not make all processing local.

ai_backend.api: Responses-based gpt-6-sol high reasoning through a supported ChatGPT-plan adapter, preferably minimal local Codex app-server where qualified; care service owns tool execution. API-key billing is an explicitly selected fallback.
ai_backend.speech_policy: Qualify speech input/output independently around Sol high. The documented ChatGPT-plan flow excludes audio input/transcription; MCP transport grants no speech coverage. Compare supported local and low-cost hosted choices and test actual device audio, latency, interruption, privacy and costs. Never replace the selected Sol brain with a speech model; do not retain raw audio by default. Free participant-selectable voice auditions are required; compare licensed local Kokoro, Piper per-voice model terms and browser speechSynthesis where available. Natural turn taking requires explicit state/timing contracts and live device testing; foreground wake processing may stream to the local server, not necessarily run on the phone. See docs/architecture/VOICE_AND_DAILY_COMPANION_2026-10-05.md.

reasoning_route.account_policy: Use app-specific supported authentication with explicit plan-usage consent where required. Verify intended user and local/remote deployment eligibility, exact model/high effort, renewal/revocation and allowance limits. Never copy Cerberus credentials or infer shared entitlement from administrator status.

tool_connection.authorization: Model, local MCP and any tunnel all reach the same authenticated typed care commands. Enforce client/role scope and receipts in the care service; no generic shell or inherited ambient tools.
